records.english: Unfortunately, Carrots refused to concede and demanded a recount, and we’re still fighting with Carrots.
records.translation: 可惜，「胡萝卜」不肯认输，还要求重新计票；我们到现在还在跟它争呢。
records.speaker: Donald J. Trump

document.zh: 2018 年感恩节火鸡赦免仪式

context.en: At the turkey pardon, Trump joked about a White House website vote between two turkeys, Peas and Carrots.
context.zh: 在火鸡赦免仪式上，特朗普拿白宫网站上两只火鸡「豌豆」和「胡萝卜」之间的投票开玩笑。

records.english: Peas, I hereby grant you a full pardon!
records.speaker: Donald J. Trump

document.zh: 2018 年感恩节火鸡赦免仪式

context.en: After announcing pardons for both birds, Trump addressed Peas directly.
context.zh: 在宣布两只火鸡都将获赦后，特朗普直接对着「豌豆」说了这句话。

records.english: So, Tater and Tot, you can rest easy.
records.translation: 所以，「薯块」和「薯球」，你们可以放心了。
records.speaker: Donald J. Trump

document.zh: 2017 年感恩节火鸡赦免仪式

context.en: Tater and Tot were turkeys pardoned by Barack Obama the year before. Trump joked about whether their pardons could be revoked.
context.zh: 「薯块」和「薯球」是奥巴马前一年赦免的两只火鸡。特朗普在仪式上打趣，说起能不能撤销它们的赦免。

records.english: We’ve hosted dozens of incredible world leaders, members of Congress, and, along the way, a few very strange birds.
records.translation: 我们接待过几十位了不起的世界领导人，也接待过国会议员；这期间，还来了几只相当古怪的鸟。
records.speaker: Donald J. Trump

document.zh: 2017 年感恩节火鸡赦免仪式

context.en: Trump listed White House visitors before introducing Drumstick, the turkey being honored in the Rose Garden.
context.zh: 在玫瑰园介绍当天的主角、火鸡 Drumstick 之前，特朗普先数起了白宫接待过的客人。

records.english: We extend our best wishes, and we also want them to have luck — a very important word.
records.translation: 我们送上最好的祝愿，也希望他们有好运——这个词很重要。
records.speaker: Donald J. Trump

document.zh: 向全国发表的告别演说

context.en: In his farewell address, “them” refers to the incoming administration.
context.zh: 在告别演说中，「他们」指即将上任的新一届政府。

records.english: I had not spent my career as a politician, but as a builder looking at open skylines and imagining infinite possibilities.
records.translation: 我过去的职业不是从政，而是搞建筑，望着开阔的天际线，想象无限的可能。
records.speaker: Donald J. Trump

document.zh: 向全国发表的告别演说

context.en: Looking back at his entry into politics, Trump described how he saw his earlier career.
context.zh: 特朗普回顾自己步入政坛的经历，谈到他如何看待从政前的职业。

records.english: I think every one of the military leaders here knows that space is a vacuum, but we’re not operating in a vacuum.
records.translation: 我想，在场的军事领导人都知道，太空是真空，但我们的行动并非在真空中进行。
records.speaker: Mike Pence

document.en: First anniversary of the Space Force
document.zh: 太空军成立一周年纪念活动

context.en: Vice President Pence used the two senses of “vacuum” while discussing international competition in space.
context.zh: 副总统彭斯谈到太空领域的国际竞争，用「真空」一词同时指物理环境和与外界隔绝的状态。

records.english: And we will pursue our manifest destiny into the stars, launching American astronauts to plant the Stars and Stripes on the planet Mars.
records.translation: 我们还将把追寻「天定命运」的脚步迈向星空，把美国宇航员送上太空，去火星插上星条旗。
records.speaker: Donald J. Trump

context.en: In his second inaugural address, Trump presented a future ambition for American space exploration.
context.zh: 特朗普在第二次就职演说中谈到了美国太空探索的未来目标。

records.english: In America, the impossible is what we do best.
records.translation: 在美国，我们最擅长的就是做不可能的事。
records.speaker: Donald J. Trump

context.en: Near the end of the address, Trump connected his return to office with the idea of overcoming the impossible.
context.zh: 临近演说结尾，特朗普从自己重返白宫谈到战胜看似不可能之事。

records.english: We will follow two simple rules: Buy American and Hire American.
records.translation: 我们将遵循两条简单的原则：买美国货，雇美国人。
records.speaker: Donald J. Trump

document.zh: 2017 年就职演说 · 预备讲稿

context.en: The first inaugural text, marked “as prepared for delivery,” sets out priorities on purchasing and employment.
context.zh: 第一份就职演说文本注明为预备讲稿，这里谈的是采购和就业方面的优先事项。

records.english: The time for empty talk is over.
records.translation: 空谈的时候已经过去了。
records.speaker: Donald J. Trump

document.zh: 2017 年就职演说 · 预备讲稿

context.en: In the prepared inaugural text, this line introduces a call for action.
context.zh: 在就职演说预备讲稿里，这句话引出对行动的呼吁。

records.english: Paper straws often come individually wrapped in plastic, undermining the environmental argument for their use.
records.translation: 纸吸管常常是一根一根用塑料包装的，这削弱了出于环保考虑使用纸吸管的理由。
records.speaker: The White House

document.en: Fact sheet on federal purchases of paper straws
document.zh: 关于联邦政府采购纸吸管的情况说明

context.en: The White House gave this argument in a fact sheet about federal straw procurement. The wording is attributed to the institution.
context.zh: 白宫在一份关于联邦政府采购吸管的情况说明中提出了这一理由。这是白宫的文件表述。
